items.title: Memanto: Typed Semantic Memory with Information-Theoretic Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: Memanto：面向长时程智能体的类型化语义记忆与信息论检索
items.summary: Memanto is a universal agent memory layer combining a typed semantic schema with thirteen memory categories, automated conflict resolution and temporal versioning, backed by Moorcheh's index-free information-theoretic search. It reports state-of-the-art 89.8% on LongMemEval and 87.1% on LoCoMo with a single retrieval query and no ingestion cost, surpassing evaluated hybrid graph and vector systems.

items.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.5, described as a model built for complex tasks such as coding, research and data analysis across tools.

items.title: The Coin Flip Judge? Reliability and Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
items.title_zh: 抛硬币式评审？LLM 作为评审的可靠性与偏差
items.summary: The study runs repeated identical LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations on 29 tasks with 50 pairwise and 50 pointwise trials per question. Pairwise preferences flip 13.6% of the time on average, 28% of questions exceed a 20% flip rate, cross-judge agreement is 76%, and about 11 repeated trials are needed for a majority vote to recover the 50-trial verdict with 95% probability.

items.title: Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks in AI: A Taxonomy-Driven Evaluation Framework
items.title_zh: AI 中的涌现性策略推理风险：分类体系驱动的评估框架
items.summary: ESRRSim is a taxonomy-driven agentic framework for evaluating emergent strategic reasoning risks such as deception, evaluation gaming and reward hacking. Across 11 reasoning LLMs, detection rates ranged from 14.45% to 72.72%.

items.title: Incentivizing Neuro-symbolic Language-based Reasoning in VLMs via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 通过强化学习激励视觉语言模型中的神经符号语言推理
items.summary: The work explores representing vision-language concepts in a neuro-symbolic language and post-trains Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct for it on four H200 GPU nodes. It reports a 3.33% accuracy gain on a math, science and general-knowledge vision-language benchmark while cutting reasoning tokens by 75% relative to SymPy.

items.title: PrivUn: Unveiling Latent Ripple Effects and Shallow Forgetting in Privacy Unlearning
items.title_zh: PrivUn：揭示隐私遗忘中的潜在涟漪效应与浅层遗忘
items.summary: PrivUn evaluates unlearning robustness through direct retrieval, in-context learning recovery and fine-tuning restoration attacks, adding forgetting scores, association metrics and forgetting-depth assessment. It finds that privacy unlearning propagates along latent gradient-based associations and is often shallow, leaving private information distributed across deep model layers; association-aware coreset selection and multi-layer representational constraints are explored as remedies.

items.title: Transient Turn Injection: Exposing Stateless Multi-Turn Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 瞬态轮次注入：暴露大语言模型无状态多轮交互漏洞
items.summary: Transient Turn Injection is a multi-turn attack that distributes adversarial intent across isolated interactions to exploit stateless moderation, using automated attacker agents. Evaluations across models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and open-source alternatives find wide variation in resilience and surface model-specific vulnerabilities, especially in medical and high-stakes domains.

items.title: AutoRISE: Agent-Driven Strategy Evolution for Red-Teaming Large Language Models
items.title_zh: AutoRISE：面向大语言模型红队的智能体驱动策略演化
items.summary: AutoRISE searches over executable attack programs rather than individual prompts: a coding agent edits an attack strategy while a fixed evaluation harness scores the resulting attacks and returns diagnostics for the next edit. Evaluated on 11 models from five families across seven jailbreak datasets, it improves average attack success by 17.0 points over the strongest baseline on held-out models in a black-box, inference-only setting.

items.title: Same Methods, Different Rankings: Trainable Depth as an Evaluation Variable in Continual Learning
items.title_zh: 相同方法，不同排名：可训练深度作为持续学习中的评估变量
items.summary: The paper treats the fine-tuning regime, defined by the trainable parameter subspace, as an evaluation variable for continual learning. Across five methods, five trainable-depth regimes, five datasets and eleven task orders per dataset, method rankings are not consistently preserved, and deeper adaptation is associated with larger update magnitudes, more forgetting and a stronger relationship between the two.

items.title: An End-to-End Ukrainian RAG for Local Deployment. Optimized Hybrid Search and Lightweight Generation
items.title_zh: 面向本地部署的端到端乌克兰语 RAG：优化的混合检索与轻量生成
items.summary: The paper describes a Ukrainian document question-answering RAG system that placed second in the UNLP 2026 Shared Task, combining a two-stage retrieval pipeline with a Ukrainian language model fine-tuned on synthetic data. Compression and lightweight generation target local deployment under strict compute limits.

items.title: Knowledge-driven Augmentation and Retrieval for Integrative Temporal Adaptation
items.title_zh: 知识驱动的增强与检索：面向一体化时序适应
items.summary: KARITA is a knowledge-driven augmentation and retrieval method for temporal adaptation that draws on knowledge sources such as the MeSH medical ontology and uses shifting insights to guide retrieval-augmented learning. It reports consistent improvements on clinical, legal and scientific classification tasks.

items.title: aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws
items.title_zh: aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws：AWS 官方 AI Agent 工具包
items.summary: AWS released an official AWS-supported toolkit of MCP servers, skills and plugins intended to help AI agents build on AWS.

items.title: future-agi/future-agi
items.title_zh: future-agi/future-agi：开源 LLM 与 AI Agent 评测观测平台
items.summary: future-agi is an open-source, self-hostable Apache 2.0 Python platform for evaluating, observing and improving LLM and AI-agent applications, with tracing, evals, simulations, datasets, a gateway and guardrails.
